title: kaiak protocol: shared definitions
description: Definitions the control-protocol messages share (docs/specs/CONTROL-PROTOCOL.md, Messages). IDs, model names and timestamps come from config.schema.json.

instance.description: A gateway's instance ID (KAIAK_INSTANCE_ID, default the hostname). Also sent in the Kaiak-Instance header, so it is header-safe.

config_hash.description: A config's content hash: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the config's JSON text exactly as the control plane sends it. It identifies content and carries no order.

count.description: A non-negative integer a JavaScript number holds exactly (at most 2^53 - 1).

amount.description: A used amount in a limit window, as a string of decimal digits (at most 18, so below 10^18): requests, tokens, or nano-USD for USD limits. A string, not a number, because a month of spend in nano-USD can pass 2^53, where a JavaScript number stops being exact.
